name: crypto-market-snapshot
description: Current USD price snapshot for one or more crypto tokens by CoinGecko id (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, usd-coin, ...) in a single paid call. Returns live spot price, symbol, and confidence per token — sourced from DefiLlama via the agentexchange store. Use for portfolio checks, agent pricing decisions, or any quick token valuation.

ids.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko token ids to price, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum,solana,usd-coin

steps.label: token prices — agentexchange crypto/prices (routed x402 via SELAT Router)
